name: Lighthouse

project.name: Lighthouse (HarbourMasters Banjo-Kazooie PC port on libultraship)

assets.needs: Banjo-Kazooie .z64 ROM (USA rev0/rev1, PAL or JP are recognised by the bundled Torch config). The app verifies it, copies it as baserom.us.z64 and converts it into bk.o2r on the device.
assets.location: /sdcard/Android/data/com.lighthouse.android/files/ (GameAssets: getExternalFilesDir, falling back to internal files). Mods go in the mods folder there.
assets.notes: The picker text asks for a .z64, so a byte-swapped .n64 dump may need converting first (not checked).

settings.in_app_menu: In game: the libultraship ImGui menu bar (Settings, Enhancements, Network, Developer Tools); controller combo or touch to open (not checked on device).
settings.summary: Settings > Graphics: Internal Resolution 0.5-2.0, MSAA 1-8, Current FPS 30 up to display rate (frame interpolation), Match Refresh Rate, VSync, Texture Filter (Three-Point/Linear/None), renderer API. Enhancements: Extended Draw Distance 1-6x, Disable LOD, cutscene aspect, camera free-look/invert, note/Jinjo retention, cutscene skips, many bug fixes and cheats.

controls: SDL2 gamecontroller (bundled gamecontrollerdb.txt); remapping in the libultraship input editor, stored under CVars.gSettings.Controllers in lighthouse.cfg.json. Controls scheme options (Talon Trot toggle, etc.).
display: Single screen (no secondary-display code in the APK).
saves: In the app folder /sdcard/Android/data/com.lighthouse.android/files/ (SaveStore/SavesActivity manage them; file names not checked).
notes: Same game as Banjo: Recompiled but a different technique (decomp + libultraship, so it has HarbourMasters enhancements, randomizer and Anchor multiplayer upstream). The official HarbourMasters releases (latest 1.2.2, 2026-10-30) ship no Android build; izzy2lost's fork has one release (1.0.2, 2026-08-07, based on an older upstream). Listed in the RetroHandhelds Obtainium recomp list as id com.lighthouse.android.
verified: On device: dumpsys, data dir. APK: GameAssets/LauncherActivity (paths, ROM name), assets/gamedata.zip config.yml (Banjo-Kazooie hashes), libmain.so strings (lighthouse.cfg.json, CVar names). Source: izzy2lost/Lighthouse at HEAD (src/port/UI/LighthouseMenuSettings.cpp, LighthouseMenuEnhancements.cpp). libultraship submodule not cloned, so texture-filter default is from libultraship convention.
